conclusion: Compiler did not eliminate duplicate pick in baseline Off/Trace. Candidate actual shipping-linked worker performs one selection scan and consumes its cached selection; both modes structurally remove second65slot scan on ordinary successful predicate-to-claim path. Offcode shrinks but Tracecode grows slightly; no runtime speed/frequency gain claimed.
path_invariant: Predicate, stopping/presentation priority, generation check and selection take occur under same worker mutex; priority branches continue before consuming cached selection. No candidate selection is reused across unlock/wait/presentation callback. No extra ready-queue state introduced.
scope_limits: Wait wakeups may repeat the first scan and optional priority work can divert; not all worker iterations claim a job.
Code-size/instruction counts are static and do not quantify executed cycles/cache effects or whole-game performance.
Offworker is also used for waits telemetry per configure mode branch; tracer instrumentation remains different.
Map.o was not the selected shipping COMDAT for ee45 or96da; broad mismatches rejected rather than falsely masked. Actual EngineRun.o bound independently with fresh addresses for each role.
Native suite/game conformance and timing still owned by root; no runtime execution performed by assembly review.
